PROJECT / 0140+ pieces of equipment digitized

Counting products on a conveyor belt

TASK
Automatically and continuously monitor the number of products manufactured.
HOW IT WORKS
The system tracks objects using bounding boxes. When a newly tracked object first enters the counting region (ROI), the total counter increases by one.
MY CONTRIBUTION
End-to-end development, from data annotation to system integration and ongoing support.
RESULT
Approximately 95% counting accuracy based on my cross-check of the system's results. This is an indicative estimate from practical validation.
YOLOTrackingROIObject counting
PROJECT / 02Deployed and operational

Counting containers and identifying their state

TASK
Automatically and continuously count outgoing containers and identify whether they are open or closed.
HOW IT WORKS
YOLO and ByteTrack detect and track containers. Passing through the CHECK and PHOTO regions determines when to capture an image, which ResNet uses to classify the container as open or closed.
MY CONTRIBUTION
End-to-end development, from data annotation to system integration and ongoing support.
RESULT
The system is deployed for automatic container counting and state classification.
YOLOByteTrackROIResNetClassification
PROJECT / 03Deployed and operational on 50+ cameras

Counting people and analyzing their posture in the frame

TASK
Count people in the frame. For some cameras, also determine whether a person is sitting or standing and which body parts remain visible when barriers obscure them.
HOW IT WORKS
Person detection was used to count people in the frame. Some tasks also included analyzing posture and the visibility of body parts.
SCALE
Worked on people-counting tasks across more than 50 cameras; posture analysis was applied to a subset of them.
People countingPose estimationOcclusionVideo analytics
LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS/02

Large language models

I deploy and integrate local language models to process and analyze text, documents and events. I tune inference for the available hardware and task requirements.

PROJECT / 01Deployed and operational

Conversational event analytics

TASK
Retrieve event information and statistics for a selected period using natural language questions.
HOW IT WORKS
The web platform receives events from two video analytics sources and stores them as JSON. In a dedicated chat window, users ask questions about each source: what happened, where and when. Numerical metrics are calculated in code, while Qwen 3.5 9B generates answers based on the data.
MY CONTRIBUTION
Built the entire web platform from scratch: event storage, metric calculations, language model integration and the chat interface.
RESULT
One interface for querying recorded events and statistics, with separate source and time range selection.
EXAMPLE QUESTION

“Hi, how many cars passed in the past hour?”

Qwen 3.5 9BJSONChat interfaceEvent analytics
PROJECT / 02Local inference · MLX

Local Desk - a local AI assistant

TASK
Build a local AI assistant for conversation, text work, coding help and document analysis, with models running on the user's computer.
HOW IT WORKS
The macOS application runs language models locally through MLX and provides a chat interface. Users can attach documents and spreadsheets: the app extracts their text, recognizes scans using OCR and, for large files, selects relevant passages based on the user's question.
FEATURES
Open-ended conversation, code generation and explanation, text work and attached file analysis. Model selection, streamed responses, conversation history, result export and releasing model memory.
RESULT
A local AI assistant in one interface: answering questions, helping with text and code, and analyzing attached documents.
EXAMPLE QUESTION

“Briefly summarize the report: what improved, which issue remains, and what is planned?”

PythonPySide6MLXOCRDocument analysis

I recognize text and numerical values in images and camera frames. I use YOLO to locate the recognition region, and EasyOCR and Tesseract / pytesseract to extract text.

PROJECT / 01Deployed and operational

Vehicle entry and exit monitoring

TASK
Automatically monitor vehicle entry and exit using license plate numbers.
HOW IT WORKS
YOLO detects the license plate region in an image. EasyOCR recognizes the characters within that region.
RESULT
The database stores the recognized license plate number, the entry or exit event, and its timestamp.
